holes.name: ErdosFaberLovaszConjecture.theorem_1_1
holes.body:
/--
Statement of Theorem 1.1:

For sufficiently large `n : ℕ`, every linear hypergraph on `n` vertices has chromatic index
at most `n`.
-/
theorem theorem_1_1 :
    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, ∀ 𝓗 : Hypergraph (Fin n), 𝓗.IsLinear → 𝓗.chromaticIndex ≤ n := by
  sorry
